detail: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un oversaw the launch of an intermediate-range strategic missile using a hypersonic weapons system, state media said, underscoring his intent to further strengthen the country’s nuclear deterrent. (Bloomberg)

pyongyang.title: North Korea test-fires intermediate-range missile amid mine blast tensions
detail: North Korea said it tested an intermediate-range strategic missile on Saturday that involved the use of AI, hours after Seoul said Pyongyang had launched a ballistic missile. (Dawn)

North Korea said on Saturday it test-fired an intermediate-range ballistic missile that it claimed has manoeuvrable flight capabilities designed to evade missile defences in South Korea and Japan. The latest test comes amid heightened tensions between the two Koreas over border landmine blasts. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: 8 public officers in Singapore referred to police after property review
detail: Singapore has referred cases involving eight public officers to the police after reviewing property purchases by officials who worked at agencies involved in rail planning, Coordinating Minister for Public Services Chan Chun Sing told parliament on Tuesday. (Bloomberg)

Eight public service officers have been referred to Singapore police after a review of 191 officers’ property transactions, Coordinating Minister for Public Services Chan Chun Sing has told parliament. (South China Morning Post)
